claim: Early characterisation of thymosin beta-4 as a ubiquitous peptide.
Thymosin beta-4 promotes cardiac cell migration, survival and repair after infarction in mice (integrin-linked kinase activation).
Synthesis and characterisation of the N-terminal acetylated 17-23 fragment of thymosin beta-4 — the form identified as TB-500.
Doping-control analytical method for TB-500 (equine); reflects WADA interest in the substance.

title: FDA PCAC meeting briefing package (23–24 July 2026)
claim: TB-500-related bulk drug substances were reviewed at the July 2026 Pharmacy Compounding Advisory Committee meeting alongside other peptides.
